ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a folded strip inside a long rectangle labeled 27 cm along the bottom. The strip is 3 cm wide, as shown in the right inset. The strip alternates between light vertical rectangular parts and dark folded parts. The inset also shows that an end vertical light portion has length 6 cm. In the main diagram, tracing the strip from left to right gives a light vertical end piece, then four dark horizontal folded runs across the 9 cm width of the rectangle, with three internal light vertical connector pieces between those dark runs, and a final light vertical end piece. Reasoning: Since the strip is 3 cm wide, the diagram’s vertical connector pieces that are one strip-width long each measure 3 cm. The two end vertical light pieces each measure 6 cm, as shown by the inset. Each dark horizontal run spans the 9 cm width of the bounding rectangle, and there are four such runs. Therefore the total strip length is 6 + 9 + 3 + 9 + 3 + 9 + 3 + 9 + 6 = 57 cm.
